selection: among candidates within the unchanged background budget, maximize injected validation event F1; ties: lower background event rate, lower k, lower clip, higher tau; if none meets budget choose lowest background rate then highest injection F1
supplement_selection: NAB realAdExchange, fixed daily period; ASCII first 3 with regular finite sampling, first-40%-training >=8 cycles and lag correlation >=0.5; all candidates screened without test labels
event_boundary: merge alerts over the full scored prefix before restricting by event start; label windows inclusive; one TP per window, extra events FP; outside exposure uses sample grid cells
fixed_boundary: freeze all state at the training/validation boundary
